_comment: Tier-2 for axisymmetric:3 and :5. axisymmetric:3 — 'global weight cell radius' has two ordering constraints with two DIFFERENT messages, both matched verbatim: 'ERROR: Cannot use weight cell radius unless axisymmetric (../grid.cpp:1997)' when the boundary is not 'ar', and 'ERROR: Cannot weight cells before grid is defined (../grid.cpp:1983)' when it precedes create_grid; boundary-then-grid-then-weight runs. axisymmetric:5 — the 'Axisymm bad moves = 0' line is printed by all three completed runs INCLUDING the plain 'boundary o o p' non-axisymmetric one, which is the entry's point: presence carries no information, only a nonzero value does.
